introduction: Healthy Texas Women provides limited family-planning services. It has its own eligibility conditions and is not comprehensive health insurance.
description: Healthy Texas Women provides limited family-planning services. It has its own eligibility conditions and is not comprehensive health insurance.

sections.who: HHS reviews Texas residence, income, citizenship or eligible status, age and insurance conditions. Applicants must not be pregnant. Parent or guardian application rules apply to eligible minors.
sections.get: Approved services include family-planning care, contraception and related screenings or treatment.
sections.docs:
• Identity and Texas residence.
  • Income and insurance information.
  • Requested citizenship or immigration evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Review program conditions

    Read HHS eligibility guidance.

  2. Request application help

    A local HHS office or participating family-planning provider can assist.

  3. Submit medical application

    Use the HHS medical-benefit application route and provide requested verification.
sections.after: Check the decision and locate a participating provider before scheduling covered services.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using HTW conditions and application assistance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
